title: Close resolved support tickets automatically
text: Resolved support tickets that nobody reopens stay RESOLVED forever. Add a nightly job that closes every ticket that has been RESOLVED for longer than a configurable number of days (default 14), and the service method it calls.
interface: `com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.repositories.SupportTicketRepository#findByStatusAndResolvedTimeBefore(TicketStatus status, LocalDateTime cutoff)` returning `List<SupportTicket>`.

`com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.services.SupportTicketService#closeStaleResolvedTickets(int olderThanDays)` returning `int`: every ticket with status RESOLVED and `resolvedTime` before now minus the given days becomes CLOSED and is saved; returns how many.

`com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.services.StaleTicketCloseCronJob` with a public no-argument method `closeStaleTickets()`, a boolean field `enabled` (property `support.ticket.stale-close.enabled`, default true) and an int field `olderThanDays` (property `support.ticket.stale-close.days`, default 14); its schedule comes from property `support.ticket.stale-close.cron` (default `0 30 3 * * *`). When disabled it does nothing; a failure of the service is logged, not thrown.

title: Protect support tickets against lost updates
text: An administrator and the customer can change the same support ticket at the same moment (a status change and a customer reply), and the last write silently wins. Protect support tickets against lost updates.
interface: `com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.models.SupportTicket` gets a field `version` of type `Long` used for optimistic locking.
The table `support_ticket` gets a column `version` (BIGINT, NOT NULL, default 0).

title: Send the ticket confirmation after the ticket is committed
text: When a support ticket is created, the confirmation e-mail is sent from inside the database transaction that creates the ticket. A slow mail server holds the transaction open, and when the transaction rolls back after the e-mail went out, the customer holds a reference to a ticket that does not exist. Send the confirmation only after the ticket has been committed.
interface: `com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.event.SupportTicketCreatedEvent` with a constructor `(Object source, Long ticketId, String contactEmail, String ticketReference, String subject, String language, String statusToken)` and a getter for each of the six values (`getTicketId()`, `getContactEmail()`, `getTicketReference()`, `getSubject()`, `getLanguage()`, `getStatusToken()`).

`com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.event.SupportTicketCreatedEventListener` with a public method `onTicketCreated(SupportTicketCreatedEvent event)` that sends the confirmation with `EmailService#sendTicketCreationConfirmation(to, ticketReference, subject, language, statusToken)`.
`SupportTicketService#createTicket` publishes that event through Spring's `ApplicationEventPublisher` and no longer calls `EmailService` itself.

title: Convert amounts to PLN through a replaceable rate provider
text: Finance wants amounts in other currencies converted to PLN. The rates will come from an external provider later; for now they are fixed in configuration. Add the conversion so that the provider can be swapped without touching the code that converts.
interface: `com.sm.instagram.platform.currency.port.ExchangeRatePort` with `Optional<BigDecimal> rateToPln(String isoCode)`.
`com.sm.instagram.platform.currency.adapter.FixedExchangeRateProperties`, bound to the property prefix `currency.fixed-rates`, holding `Map<String, BigDecimal> rates` (`getRates()`, `setRates(...)`).

`com.sm.instagram.platform.currency.adapter.FixedExchangeRateAdapter` implementing the port, constructor `(FixedExchangeRateProperties properties)`; the ISO code matches case-insensitively and `PLN` is always 1.

`com.sm.instagram.platform.currency.CurrencyConversionService` with constructor `(ExchangeRatePort exchangeRatePort)` and `BigDecimal toPln(BigDecimal amount, String isoCode)`: amount times rate, rounded to 2 decimals HALF_UP. When no rate exists it throws an exception that carries the message key `error.business.exchange_rate_unavailable` with the ISO code as its argument.

title: Reorder the FAQs of a category in one request
text: Admins want to reorder the FAQs of a category in one request instead of editing each FAQ's display order.
interface: `PUT /support/faq/categories/{categoryId}/order` (administrators only) with a body `com.sm.instagram.platform.support.faq.dtos.FaqReorderDtoIn` that holds `List<Long> faqIds` (`getFaqIds()`, `setFaqIds(...)`); responds 204.

`com.sm.instagram.platform.support.faq.services.FaqService#reorderCategory(Long categoryId, List<Long> faqIds)`: the list must hold exactly the ids of the category's active FAQs, each once, in any order; the FAQ at position i gets display order i + 1 and is saved. Otherwise it throws an exception that carries the message key `error.business.faq_reorder_mismatch`. An unknown category keeps the existing not-found behaviour.

title: Store and return a display order for currencies
text: Currencies should appear in an order the team chooses (PLN first), not alphabetically. Store a display order for every currency and return it to clients.
interface: `com.sm.instagram.platform.currency.Currency` gets `int displayOrder`, stored in a column `display_order` (INT, NOT NULL, default 0) of the table `currency`.
`com.sm.instagram.platform.currency.CurrencyDtoOut` gets `displayOrder` (`getDisplayOrder()`), filled by both mapping paths of `CurrencyService`: `toDto` and `getDataPagedAndFilteredAsDtos`.

title: Tell the customer when a ticket is resolved
text: Customers are not told when their support ticket is resolved. When an administrator moves a ticket to RESOLVED, notify the customer. E-mail is today's channel, but the team plans to move notifications to another provider, so the way the notice is delivered must be replaceable.
interface: `com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.event.SupportTicketResolvedEvent` with a constructor `(Object source, Long ticketId, String contactEmail, String ticketReference)` and getters `getTicketId()`, `getContactEmail()`, `getTicketReference()`.
`SupportTicketService#updateTicketStatus` publishes it through Spring's `ApplicationEventPublisher` when the new status is RESOLVED, and only then.
`com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.port.TicketNotificationPort` with `void notifyResolved(String contactEmail, String ticketReference)`.
`com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.adapter.EmailTicketNotificationAdapter` implementing it with `EmailService#sendEmail(to, subject, text)`; the subject contains the ticket reference.

`com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.event.SupportTicketResolvedEventListener` with a constructor `(TicketNotificationPort port)` and a public method `onTicketResolved(SupportTicketResolvedEvent event)`; a failure of the port is logged, not thrown.

title: Ticket counts per status for a period
text: Support administrators want to see how many tickets were created in a period, per status.
interface: `GET /support/ticket/admin/stats?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD` (administrators only) returns `com.sm.instagram.platform.support.ticket.dtos.TicketStatsDtoOut` with `Map<TicketStatus, Long> countsByStatus` (every status present, 0 when none) and `long total` (`getCountsByStatus()`, `getTotal()`).

`SupportTicketService#getTicketStats(LocalDate from, LocalDate to)` returns it. It counts with `SupportTicketRepository#countByStatusAndCreatedTimeBetween(TicketStatus status, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end)`, called with `start = from.atStartOfDay()` and `end = to.plusDays(1).atStartOfDay()`. When `from` is after `to` it throws an exception that carries the message key `error.validation.invalid_date_range`. A caller who is not an administrator gets the same insufficient-permissions error `updateTicketStatus` gives.

title: Purge FAQs that stayed inactive
text: Deactivated FAQs pile up forever. Purge the FAQs that have been inactive for longer than a configurable number of days (default 180) with a weekly job.
interface: `com.sm.instagram.platform.support.faq.repositories.FaqRepository#findByActiveFalseAndLastUpdateTimeBefore(LocalDateTime cutoff)` returning `List<Faq>`.
`FaqService#purgeInactiveOlderThan(int days)` returning `int`: deletes every FAQ with `active = false` and `lastUpdateTime` before now minus the days, and returns how many.

`com.sm.instagram.platform.support.faq.services.InactiveFaqPurgeCronJob` with a public no-argument method `purgeInactiveFaqs()`, a boolean field `enabled` (property `support.faq.purge.enabled`, default true) and an int field `olderThanDays` (property `support.faq.purge.days`, default 180); its schedule comes from property `support.faq.purge.cron` (default `0 0 4 * * SUN`). When disabled it does nothing; a failure of the service is logged, not thrown.

title: Protect user preferences against lost updates
text: Users edit their preferences from the web app and the mobile app at the same time, and one device silently overwrites the other's change. Protect user preferences against lost updates.
interface: `com.sm.instagram.platform.userpreferences.UserPreferences` gets a field `version` of type `Long` used for optimistic locking.
The table `user_preferences` gets a column `version` (BIGINT, NOT NULL, default 0).
